_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The header" is ".header"; "the toolbar" is ".header .chat-workspace-actions"; "the menu" is ".chat-overflow-popover"; "More options" is the header's button named exactly "More options". "The VM link" is the header's link a[aria-label="vm.example"]. Names of buttons are accessible names: use role and name. "Hidden" means hidden or absent. Links open in a popup (tab "popup"); "it opens P" means: tab "popup" should come to have exactly the URL P (assert_url with value P), and show an element whose whole text is exactly "Local link fixture"; then close tab "popup". Without a VM link, every configured link stays in the overflow menu, at 768px. The links are "Manage on exe.dev" (it opens https://exe.example/vm/vm) and "Documentation" (it opens https://docs.example/documentation). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new and wait for the header. 2. Eval window.toolbarCounts() with expect "{\"buttons\":3,\"links\":0}". The toolbar should have exactly 3 visible buttons (role button, count 3). 3. The header's [data-testid="live-call-header"] should be visible. 4. For each link name in turn, "Manage on exe.dev" then "Documentation": click More options; the menu's buttons named exactly "Manage on exe.dev" and "Documentation" should both be visible; click the one named exactly that name; it opens its page; the menu should then be hidden.
